plugin.name: Coolify for Termix
plugin.description: Coolify inside Termix: servers become hosts (tunnels included), one-click container shells, deploys, logs, variables, backups and alerts, and the full Coolify API.

empty.title: No Coolify connections yet
empty.hint: Coolify connections and their servers and resources will show here.

noConnection.title: No Coolify connection
noConnection.hint: Add a connection under Connections to see its resources.

view.title: View Coolify
view.description: Open the plugin and read the Coolify connections you own or were granted.

operate.title: Operate Coolify resources
operate.description: Start, stop, restart and deploy, run tasks and backups, read logs, and open container shells and consoles.

configure.title: Configure Coolify
configure.description: Edit resources, variables, storage, keys, sources, DNS and notifications, and create or import resources.

administer.title: Administer Coolify
administer.description: Delete resources, create, delete and transfer servers, provision cloud servers, change instance settings and share connections.

mcp.title: Use the Coolify MCP endpoint
mcp.description: Call the plugin's MCP endpoint. Each call still needs the permission of the action it runs.

allowPolling.label: Allow polling
allowPolling.description: Let connections poll Coolify for changes.

minPollSeconds.label: Minimum poll interval
minPollSeconds.description: The shortest time, in seconds, a connection may wait between polls.

allowKeyCopy.label: Allow copying Coolify SSH keys
allowKeyCopy.description: Copy a server's SSH key from Coolify into a Termix credential. When off, people pick an existing Termix credential instead.

allowSharing.label: Allow sharing connections
allowSharing.description: Let connection owners share a connection with other Termix users.

allowProvisioning.label: Allow cloud provisioning
allowProvisioning.description: Let people create servers at cloud providers through Coolify.

allowStatusPages.label: Allow public status pages
allowStatusPages.description: Let connection owners publish read-only status pages that anyone with the link can open.

allowMcpChanges.label: Allow changes over MCP
allowMcpChanges.description: Let MCP clients run actions that change things. Deploy and restart are allowed either way.

allowExec.label: Allow running commands in containers through the API and MCP
allowExec.description: Each connection also needs its owner to turn this on.

coolifyLinked.label: Linked to Coolify
coolifyLinked.description: This host is managed by a Coolify connection.

baseUrl.label: Coolify URL
baseUrl.description: The address you open Coolify at, like https://coolify.example.com.

token.label: API token
token.description: A Coolify API token. Recommended abilities: read, read:sensitive, write and deploy.
token.keepDescription: Leave empty to keep the stored token.

allowPrivate.label: On my local network
allowPrivate.description: Allow a private or local address for this Coolify.

caCert.label: CA certificate
caCert.description: A PEM certificate to trust when Coolify uses a private CA.

removeHosts.label: Also delete the Linked hosts
removeHosts.description: Off: the hosts made for this connection's servers stay as ordinary, editable hosts.

serverUuid.label: Coolify server
serverUuid.description: Only resources on this Coolify server (its uuid). Leave empty for all.

uuid.label: Resource
uuid.description: The uuid of an application, service, database or service part.

title.label: Title
title.description: Shown at the top of the public page.

resources.label: Resources
resources.description: The applications, services or databases the page shows, by uuid.

statusPageConnection.label: Connection
statusPageConnection.description: Only this connection's pages. Leave empty for all of yours.

statusPageUrl.label: Page URL
statusPageUrl.description: The public link. Shown once and never stored.

handoffId.label: Handoff id
handoffId.description: Takes the URL once, with the status page handoff route or the MCP tool take_status_page_url.

listConnections.title: List Coolify connections
listConnections.description: The Coolify connections you own or were granted.

connectionProbe.title: Check a Coolify connection
connectionProbe.description: Checks the Coolify version, the team and what the token may do, without changing anything.

connectionCreate.title: Connect a Coolify instance
connectionCreate.description: Checks the instance and token, then saves the connection with the token encrypted.

connectionUpdate.title: Change a Coolify connection
connectionUpdate.description: Changes a connection you own. An empty token or Cloudflare Access value keeps the stored one.

connectionDelete.title: Remove a Coolify connection
connectionDelete.description: Removes the connection from Termix. Nothing changes in Coolify, and Linked hosts become ordinary hosts.

listResourcesAll.title: List Coolify resources
listResourcesAll.description: A connection's applications, services with their parts, and databases, with status, server, project, environment and domains. No secrets.

resourceGet.title: Read a Coolify resource
resourceGet.description: One application, service, database or service part, without secrets.

statusPageList.title: List status pages
statusPageList.description: Your public status pages: title, connection and the resources each shows. Never their links.

statusPageCreate.title: Publish a status page
statusPageCreate.description: A public, read-only page with the chosen resources' status. The link is handed over once and never stored.

statusPageRotate.title: Give a status page a new link
statusPageRotate.description: The old link stops working at once. The new one is handed over once.

statusPageRevoke.title: Revoke a status page
statusPageRevoke.description: The link stops working and the page is removed.

connections.title: Connections
connections.loadFailed: The connections could not be loaded.

empty.title: No Coolify connections yet
empty.hint: Add a connection with your Coolify URL and an API token.

form.name: Name
form.tokenKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored token
form.abilitiesHint: Create the token in Coolify under Keys & Tokens, API tokens, with the abilities read, read:sensitive, write and deploy. Everything works except deletes and instance settings, and a leaked token can't wipe your resources. Add delete, or use root, only if you want those from Termix.
form.cfAccessHint: Only when your Coolify dashboard sits behind Cloudflare Access: a service token's ID and secret.
form.cfAccessKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored value
form.allowPrivateHint: Allow a private or local address, like 192.168.1.10.
form.caCertHint: Paste a PEM certificate when Coolify uses a private CA.
form.required: Name, URL and token are required.

probe.title: What the token can do
probe.scoped: This token is scoped to some projects or resources. It can't see servers, so there is no host sync, no shells and no keys, and it can't set up notifications. Applications, services, databases, deploys and logs still work.

delete.title: Remove {{name}}?
delete.description: Termix forgets this connection and its token. Nothing changes in Coolify. Hosts made for its servers become ordinary hosts.

errors.forbidden: Only the connection's owner can change it.

mcp.title: Use with an MCP client
mcp.description: Point an MCP client at this address to use the Coolify actions as tools. Each call runs as the key's user, with that user's permissions, approvals and history.
mcp.loadFailed: The MCP endpoint could not be loaded.

steps.title: Set it up
steps.key: In Termix, create an API key with the scope operations:read (read tools only) or operations:run.
steps.paste: Paste the client config into your MCP client and put the key in place of the placeholder.
steps.changes: Changes over MCP stay off until an admin turns on "Allow changes over MCP" in the plugin's settings. Read tools work either way.

causes.api-disabled: API access is turned off in Coolify.
causes.not-coolify: The address answered, but not as a Coolify API.
causes.unsupported-by-instance: This Coolify doesn't have this feature.
causes.unsupported-version: This plugin needs Coolify 4.4 or newer.

fixes.unreachable: Check the URL. If Coolify is on your local network, turn on "On my local network" under Advanced.
fixes.unauthorized: Create a new API token in Coolify and paste it here.
fixes.api-disabled: Turn on API access in Coolify, Settings, Advanced.
fixes.forbidden-ability: Give the token the read:sensitive ability in Coolify if you want this.
fixes.access-redirect: Add a Cloudflare Access service token under Advanced.
fixes.not-coolify: Use the address you open Coolify at, without /api at the end.

connect.title: Connect Coolify
connect.description: Bring your Coolify servers, applications, services and databases into Termix.
connect.intro: Add your Coolify URL and an API token. You can skip this and add connections later from the Coolify tab.

resources.title: Resources
resources.loadFailed: The resources could not be loaded.
resources.search: Search names, domains, projects and servers

empty.title: No resources
empty.hint: This connection has no applications, services or databases yet.

noMatch.title: Nothing matches
noMatch.hint: Change the search or the filters.

detail.missing: This resource is no longer in Coolify.

statusPages.title: Status pages for {{name}}
statusPages.description: A public, read-only page that shows the status of the resources you pick: their names, status and last deploy. No addresses, servers, logs or secrets. Anyone with the link can open it.
statusPages.loadFailed: The status pages could not be loaded.
statusPages.off: An admin has turned off public status pages. Existing pages answer "not found" until they are turned on again.

form.heading: New status page
form.title: Title
form.noResources: This connection has no resources to show.

created.title: Copy the link now
created.description: This link is shown once and is not stored anywhere. To get a link again, give the page a new link.

rotate.title: Give {{name}} a new link?
rotate.description: The current link stops working at once.

revoke.title: Revoke {{name}}?
revoke.description: The link stops working and the page is removed.

public.stale: Status may be out of date
